org.asynchttpclient.extras.rxjava2.maybe

Class AbstractMaybeAsyncHandlerBridge<T>

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.asynchttpclient.extras.rxjava2.maybe.AbstractMaybeAsyncHandlerBridge<T>
  • Type Parameters:
    T - the result type produced by the wrapped AsyncHandler and emitted via RxJava
    All Implemented Interfaces:
    AsyncHandler<Void>
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    AbstractMaybeProgressAsyncHandlerBridge, MaybeAsyncHandlerBridge

    public abstract class AbstractMaybeAsyncHandlerBridge<T>
extends Object
implements AsyncHandler<Void>
    Abstract base class that bridges events between the Maybe reactive base type and AsyncHandlers.

    When an event is received, it's first checked if the Rx stream has been disposed asynchronously. If so, request processing is aborted, otherwise, the event is forwarded to the wrapped handler.

    When the request is completed, the result produced by the wrapped instance is forwarded to the Maybe: If the result is null, MaybeEmitter.onComplete() is invoked, MaybeEmitter.onSuccess(Object) otherwise.

    Any errors during request processing are forwarded via MaybeEmitter.onError(Throwable).

        Called to indicate that request processing is to be aborted because the linked Rx stream has been disposed. If the delegate didn't already receive a terminal event, AsyncHandler#onThrowable(Throwable) onThrowable will be called with a DisposedException.
